ablation.name: brk_d_wll10_10ep
ablation.notes: w_ll=1.0 (3.3x baseline 0.3) + SAT + 10 epochs. Liberate LL flow-matching supervision to let the model learn LL transport (color/contrast stats DINOv2 is sensitive to). Structural change vs Stage7-16 which kept w_ll=0.3. If DINO-S>0.485, LL transport supervision is the lever.
